_comment: The Similar verses tab (components/SimilarPanel.jsx): its words and its one knob. The rules are in lib/similar.js; the pairs come from the backend's catalogue.
title: Similar verses
subtitle: Verses that read almost alike: see what tells them apart, then learn which wording is where
_comment-gap: A difference longer than this many words, on either side, is shown in Compare but never asked: past a short phrase it is a different passage to learn, not a wording to tell apart.
question: Question {n} of {of}
passed: All correct: this pair is mastered.
slipped: Slips: {n}. Compare them again, then try once more.
no-drill: These two differ in whole passages rather than a word or two, so there is nothing short to drill. Compare them instead.
none: No similar verses recorded for this surah.
error: Similar verses could not be read
fallback: They come from the Qur'an tab's own source.
